rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for things sharing the same characteristics or remaining consistent.

example.english: The high uniformity of the team’s uniform colours makes everyone look neat.
example.traditional: 呢隊制服嘅顏色一致性好高，成隊人睇落好整齊。

rows.note: Use this for the negative, tedious side of uniformity, especially in life or routine.

example.english: The uniformity of this daily routine is really hard to take.
example.traditional: 日日都係返工放工，呢種生活嘅單調性真係令人頂唔順。
